criteria = [
    ('Product category', 'external hard drive', "search_products(product_type='external hard drive')"),
    ('Price ceiling (excl. tax)', '< 50', 'search_products(max_price=49.99) + post-filter c.price < 50'),
    ('Min product rating (strict)', '> 3.8', 'search_products(min_product_rating=3.8) + post-filter c.rating > 3.8'),
    ('Min product review count (strict)', '> 6', 'post-filter c.num_product_reviews > 6') ,
    ('Ship to', 'work address', "place_order(address_id=Work address_id)")
]
print('Criteria Table:')
for row in criteria:
    print(row)
print('Criteria count:', len(criteria))

page_limit = 20
product_type = 'external hard drive'
max_price = 49.99
min_rating = 3.8

    resp = apis.amazon.search_products(
        query='',
        product_type=product_type,
        min_price=0.0,
        max_price=max_price,
        min_product_rating=min_rating,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    items = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else (resp.get('success', []) if isinstance(resp, dict) else [])
    print('page', page_index, 'items', len(items))
    if not items:
        break
    all_products.extend(items)
    page_index += 1

print('Total products fetched:', len(all_products))

# 3) Apply strict task filters
filtered = [
    p for p in all_products
    if (p.get('price', 1e18) < 50 and p.get('rating', 0) > 3.8 and p.get('num_product_reviews', 0) > 6)
]

        'rating': p.get('rating'),
        'num_product_reviews': p.get('num_product_reviews'),

    'product_id': selected_product.get('product_id'),

    'price': selected_product.get('price'),
    'rating': selected_product.get('rating'),

print('Payment card resolved:', payment_card_id, amazon_payment_cards[0])
